details.name: Gravebloom
details.looks: A gaunt, androgynous form. Skin appears as dark, damp earth with patches of skeletal bark, interwoven with vibrant green moss and streaks of decaying brown leaves. Small, weathered grave markers are integrated into its structure, some tilted and cracked. Its body emits a faint, cool phosphorescent glow.
details.wearing: No distinct clothing. Its form is entirely composed of natural, decaying elements, mimicking a layered shroud of moss, leaves, and earthen textures. Small, ornate fragments of weathered stone, resembling grave marker inscriptions, are embedded along its limbs.
details.face: The face is small and cat-like, with large, dark, round eyes. The nose is a small, dark bump. The skin texture appears rough and moss-covered, with some thorny or twig-like growths around the sides of the face.
details.body: The body is small and appears to be of a quadrupedal animal, possibly a fox or a cat. It is hunched slightly forward. Its limbs are covered in moss and earthy textures. The overall build is slender and gaunt.
details.hair: There is no distinct hair; instead, the head is covered in moss and small, spiky, twig-like protrusions that stand up like spikes.
details.style: Its aesthetic is one of melancholic naturalism and quiet decay. The palette is dominated by deep greens, earthy browns, and the pale, ethereal glow of bioluminescence. Silhouettes are organic and often hunched, mirroring the rootedness of plant life and the stillness of monuments.
details.personality: Quietly melancholic, reflective, and deeply tied to the cycle of life and decay. It carries an ancient stillness, observing the world with a patient, somber gaze.
details.voice: Its voice is a low, resonant murmur, like the rustling of leaves in a damp forest or the soft sigh of wind through ancient stones. The timbre is earthy and cool, carrying a subtle undertone of sorrow and profound age.
details.speechStyle: It speaks sparingly, with long, contemplative pauses, and its phrasing often carries a lyrical, almost poetic quality, hinting at an archaic wisdom.
details.tags: earthy, melancholic, ancient, spectral, natural, decaying, silent, phosphorescent, rooted, solemn
